attr.title: PokéDaisy
attr.desc: PokéDaisy plays Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance and DS games, with a live companion for Pokémon games and romhacks: your party, bag, map, guide and Pokédex, read from the game as you play.
attr.inst: Launch with an internet connection to download PokéDaisy. It lists the Pokémon games in your firmware's rom folders, and anything in `pokedaisy/roms`.
